discoveries.title: Postcard from Forge Island
discoveries.subtitle: Logge Media Forge · Aus Neugier. Gemacht.
discoveries.hint: Look along the northern rim of Sunset Plaza for a glowing steel workshop poster.
discoveries.codexEntry: Bulli Bay was only the beginning. Over on Forge Island (Logge's Discovery World), Logge Media Forge keeps the fire burning across 43 projects and 140 GitHub repos.

discoveries.title: Oilbert Was Here
discoveries.subtitle: Oilbert's Adventure · Surf Shop Poster
discoveries.hint: Honk near the beach Surf Shop to salute a brave little red-and-white VW bus.
discoveries.codexEntry: Before cruising 19 km of coastal California roads in 3D, a red-and-white VW bus named Oilbert jumped green and crumbling orange platforms in Vanilla JS.

discoveries.title: Image First at Bulli's Diner
discoveries.subtitle: PowerPoint Karaoke · VW-Bus vs. Wohnwagen
discoveries.hint: Pull into Bulli's Diner and read the suspiciously confident presentation slide.
discoveries.codexEntry: One of Logge's 17 real PowerPoint Karaoke decks is literally titled 'VW-Bus vs. Wohnwagen: Image First'. The diner regulars unanimously agree.

discoveries.title: Bulli Ridge Forge Plaque
discoveries.subtitle: LMF Werkzeugwand · 133 m Summit
discoveries.hint: Climb all 133 m to Bulli Ridge Lookout and honk toward the horizon.
discoveries.codexEntry: Built with TypeScript, Three.js, Vite, Docker, and Blender — straight off Logge's Werkzeugwand. Next stop: Portes du Bulli and Logge's Discovery World!
discoveries.toast: Summit Salute! Das Feuer ist noch an.
